title: uxc package manifest (uxopian-project.json)
description: The manifest of a uxopian-package: name, code, id prefixes, version and the gates uxc applies at deploy time (DESIGN §6). Unknown keys are tolerated.

$schema.description: Editor hint only: uxc ignores it (never hashed, never pushed).

name.description: Human name of the package, e.g. "Contract Management".

code.description: Short project code (lowercase, letter first, at most 8 characters) from which the four id prefixes derive, e.g. "ct" -> Ct / ct / ct- / CT_ (DESIGN §5).

idPrefixes.description: The four prefix forms every owned server id carries (lib/naming.mjs is the authority). Written by uxc init; set custom forms only when the derived ones do not fit.

pascal.description: Classes, tag classes, task classes, VF classes/instances, workflows, handler logical names (e.g. "Ct").

camel.description: Prompts, goal names, GUIConfiguration bean ids (e.g. "ct").

upper.description: Runtime ids minted by handlers and dataset rows; tag-delta value prefix (e.g. "CT_").

version.description: Package version (semver). Bumped on release; the marketplace keys versions by it.

minClientVersion.description: Minimum uxc client able to deploy every resource of this package. import, mp install and push refuse with an older client (DESIGN §8). Must be valid semver.

requires.description: Declared runtime requirements (checked by doctor/preflight and testkit, informational elsewhere).

uxc.description: Alias of minClientVersion (read when minClientVersion is absent).

llmProviders.description: LLM provider ids the prompts expect on the gateway.

llmModels.description: LLM models the prompts expect: model names, or { provider, models } per provider.

helpers.description: Gateway templating helpers the prompts call, e.g. "flowerDocsService.extractTextualContent".

f2TaskClasses.description: fast2 task classes the maps use.

supportedVersions.description: Server versions this package was tested on, per product (flowerdocs, uxopianAi or uxopian-ai, fast2). Deploy refuses a server outside the patterns (DESIGN §18). Pattern language: '*', '1.1.*', '>=1.1', exact.

registrationOrderBands.description: RegistrationOrder band per banded kind (fd.handler, fd.guiconfig, fd.script): [low, high], inclusive. uxc add allocates the lowest free integer inside it.

dataSets.description: Seed datasets: each binds a JSONL file of documents to the class its rows instantiate (fd.dataset, DESIGN §7.13).

name.description: Dataset name = the fd.dataset registry id.

path.description: Package-relative path of the JSONL file, e.g. "data/playbook.jsonl".

content.description: true when rows carry content files.

dependencies.description: Packages that must already be installed on the target, keyed by PACKAGE CODE (DESIGN §22). Value: a version range, or { versions, slug }. Range grammar (satisfiesRange): exact '1.2.3', '*', '1.x' / '1.2.*', '^1.2', '~1.2', '>=1.1', a space-AND set '>=0.4 <0.5', '^1 || ^3'; a list is OR.

versions.description: Version range(s) of the dependency (satisfiesRange grammar, e.g. '>=0.4 <0.5'; a list is OR).

slug.description: Marketplace slug, used in the fix-it command (uxc mp install <slug>).

extension.description: Opt-in extension rules (DESIGN §27): the package extends a dependency and is held to its own prefixes by uxc verify/push/mp publish.

rowKeyTags.description: Per class id (or "*"): tags whose value is a row's logical key; its last segment must carry the package's UPPER prefix.

library.description: Server-only fd.script libraries (registrationOrder null) must use this class and end with this line.

classId.description: Document class of the server-only libraries.

endMarker.description: Required last non-blank line; {id} = the script id.

extensionKit.description: Package-relative directory of this package's extension kit (default "extension-kit"), read by uxc init --extension --product-dir.

variables.description: Install-time variables ({{uxc:name}} placeholders in text resources, DESIGN §21). Never used in uxopian-project.json or registry.json.

description.description: What the value is, shown in the variable table.

required.description: Default: required when there is no default.

default.description: Value used when none is given (implies required: false).

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match.

sensitive.description: Never persisted or echoed. Avoid secrets in variables; use the keychain.

compat.description: Compatibility declaration (DESIGN §26): a package-relative path (default "compat.json") or the inline object.

includeOrder.description: Declared @include order of shared script sources (basenames); lintIncludeOrder enforces it.

agent.description: Operating policy for agents working on this package (uxc context).

target.description: Default target name (a local .uxc/target file overrides it).

protect.description: Resources an agent must not modify.

neverPull.description: Resources never to pull from the server.

patternList.description: A version pattern ('*', '1.1.*', '>=1.1', '1.2.3') or a list of them (OR).

minClientVersion.description: What uxc itself accepts as a minimum client (lib/version.mjs parseSemver + assertClientSupports): empty/null means none; otherwise 1-3 numeric parts, optional leading v, optional -prerelease and +build, surrounding spaces tolerated. Anything else is refused at import/push, hence an error here.
